I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. The main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

- **Why her:** On 20 Aug 2025, Dana posted in #north-team that Thea had reported the door 6 duplicate arrivals again on the morning shift. The cause was one trailer checking in at the kiosk and then being added by hand by dispatch.
- **Other sources:** The North team's cheat sheet also lists Thea as the main contact for the account. Dana Okafor owns the account on our side.

I only used #north-team, the #inc-qfl-sev1 incident channel (Ilse is in both) and the shared files.
